scripts.comments:pending: npx wrangler d1 execute portfolio-comments --remote --command "SELECT id, slug, author, body, created_at FROM comments WHERE approved = 0 ORDER BY created_at"
scripts.comments:list: npx wrangler d1 execute portfolio-comments --remote --command "SELECT id, slug, author, approved, created_at FROM comments ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
